messages.subject: Re: rapache and cookies
messages.body_plain:
after upgrading rapache to 1.1.18 i made the following test-page containing only

<%
setCookie('A', 'A1', expires=Sys.time()+100)
setCookie('B', 'B1', expires=Sys.time()+100)
print(str(COOKIES))
%>

and got the following output:
List of 1
 $ A: chr "A1"

if i reverse the order to
<%
setCookie('B', 'B1', expires=Sys.time()+100)
setCookie('A', 'A1', expires=Sys.time()+100)
print(str(COOKIES))
%>

i get:

List of 1
 $ B: chr "B1"

so at least for me (archlinux, r 2.15.0, rapache 1.1.18, apache 2.2.22) this is not fixed yet.

if you need any more information, i will happily provide it.

On Tuesday, March 13, 2012 6:00:31 AM UTC+1, Jeroen wrote:
> Is it correct that rapache only allows specification of one cookie
> using setCookie? I tried adding a couple of them in a single script:
>
> setCookie("foo", "bar");
> setCookie("baz", "zoo");
>
> but I only get to see the last one.
>
> According to http://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6265: "An origin server can
> include multiple Set-Cookie header fields in a single response."
>

messages.subject: Re: tryCatch Problem
messages.body_plain:
tryCatch is invoked when the script is called by the user. It doesn't catch the fact that your script contains invalid R code. Your R functions still need to be valid.

messages.body_plain:

Has anyone here tried / succeeded chrooting rApache?
